item.title: Renpho scale, Home Assistant, and reverse-engineering the API
item.description: I wanted scale readings in Home Assistant next to the rest of my apartment automations — not another siloed health app. That turned into maintaining hass_renpho (a fork of the quiet community integration), running APKLeaks on the Android client, and a Lovelace board I still open when training or sleep changes. Version française.
